> 第六章 玄机老人（第1页）
然而半个时辰过去了，韩猛却还未现身，只有岳千重一人在比武场上等了许久。
霸王枪徐天波忍不住问道：“莫非这韩猛怕了不成，不敢出来？”
“我看未必。”万马堂马千里有些担忧地说道：“这韩猛位列江湖十大高手，绝非虚名之辈，我看他是故意拖延，消耗岳老哥的锐气！”
话音刚落，但见庄前人群纷纷闪开，韩猛提着一口开山大斧来到场内，看见等待的岳千重说道：“不好意思，让岳老久等了，韩某这一口大斧很久没有用了，刚才磨了两磨。”
岳千重忍住怒气，拔剑在手道：“请。”韩猛也道：“请。”话必两人便交上了手。
岳千重使的是一套“苍南剑法”，源自点苍派的“苍穹三十二式”，后经岳千重演化为四十六招，增添了许多变化，并重新命名为“苍南剑法”，岳千重的苍南剑客便是由此得名。这套剑法讲究横削直刺，招式老辣迅捷，势若银蛇，几十招下来，韩猛只顾防守，只攻出了十招。场外的人看得目不转睛连连叫好，尤其是下注买了“苍南剑客”赢的人心想：“果然没有看错，岳千重人老剑却未老！早知道多下它几十两银子。”
但韩猛的心里却暗有打算，他早就知道岳千重二十年前与塞外双魔一战中元气大伤，至今功力只恢复了五成，所以并不着急。岳千重的剑法虽然厉害，他只需稳固防守，四处游斗，消耗岳千重的体力，便能立于不败之地。
果然，岳千重练攻了五十招之后，老脸已现汗水，剑法明显有些凝重了。这时韩猛长啸一声，在岳千重的剑网中呼呼攻出三斧，只听“叮当”几声金铁交鸣，岳千重被震退好几步，未等岳千重稳住身形，韩猛冲上去又是一斧，岳千重急忙挥剑架住，只听又是“当”的一声，岳千重虎口一阵发麻，差点拿不住剑。韩猛狞然一笑，左手挥出一拳击在岳千重剑身之上，这时岳千重终于忍不住一口鲜血，倒坐在地。
原来这韩猛练的是少林的“百步神拳”，讲究的是借物击物、隔空打牛。这一拳击出，内藏韩猛十成内力，穿过岳千重的剑直逼内腑。岳千重内力不济，顿时被震得一口内伤，想要再打已是难以再继。
但听韩猛说道：“老匹夫，还不弃剑认输，老子饶你不死！”
岳千重喘息着呼吸，痛苦地说道：“老夫输了，命，你拿去，剑，没有！”
韩猛一挥手，十几个劲装大汉上来，准备要将岳千重拿下。王振、徐天波和马千里正准备出手拼死一救，韩猛身后突然有个声音，冷冷地道：“你就是韩猛！”
韩猛听到这个声音之时，只觉身后忽然一阵寒气，一种令他窒息的寒气，几欲使他动弹不得。他连忙在空中一个翻身，转身落下，然后他看清楚了，那边只一个青年站在那里，以一种嘲弄的眼神看着他。
韩猛恼羞成怒，骂道：“小子，报上名来，躲躲藏藏在人背后，我看你活腻了！”
那青年正是萧无恨，他拔出了剑，冷冷地说道：“你死了，也就用不着知道我是谁了。”
话音刚落，韩猛提斧冲了上去，叫道“找死，小子！”挥手一斧便是最烈的杀着“开天辟地”。可是他的斧终究没有碰到萧无恨，虽然那斧很快很猛。萧无恨已经刺出了一剑，很奇怪的一剑，后发而先至，从这“开天辟地”这一招的破绽中穿出，刺在韩猛的咽喉上，不多不少，刚好三分。韩猛只觉眼前一黑，喉头冰凉，脸上带着惊惧和不信，缓缓地倒了下去。
众人目瞪口呆，全都没有反应过来，萧无恨已走，远处又听见了他的箫声，凄婉的箫声……

> Chapter 6 The Mysterious Old Man (Page 1)
However, half an hour had passed and Han Meng had not yet appeared. Only Yue Qianzhong had been waiting in the competition field for a long time.
Overlord Spear Xu Tianbo couldn't help but ask: "Is it possible that Han Meng is afraid and doesn't dare to come out?"
"I don't think so." Wanma Hall Ma Qianli said with some worry: "This Han Meng is one of the top ten masters in the world, and he is by no means an unworthy person. I think he is deliberately delaying and draining Brother Yue's energy!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the crowd in front of the village moved away. Han Meng came to the venue with a big mountain-breaking ax. When he saw Yue Qianzhong waiting, he said, "I'm sorry to keep Yue Lao waiting. Han has not used this big ax for a long time. I just sharpened it twice."
Yue Qianzhong suppressed his anger, drew his sword in his hand and said: "Please." Han Meng also said: "Please." After that, the two of them exchanged hands.
What Yue Qianzhong used was a set of "Cangnan Sword Techniques", which originated from the "Thirty-two Styles of the Sky" of the Diancang Sect. Later, Yue Qianzhong evolved it into forty-six moves, added many changes, and renamed it "Cangnan Sword Techniques". Yue Qianzhong's Cangnan Swordsman got his name from this. This set of swordsmanship emphasizes horizontal cuts and straight thrusts, and the moves are sharp and fast, as powerful as a silver snake. After dozens of moves, Han Meng only focused on defense and only managed ten attacks. People outside the venue watched intently and cheered, especially those who bet on "Cangnan Swordsman" and thought: "Sure enough, Yue Qianzhong's old sword is not old yet! I would have known that I would have spent dozens of taels of silver on it."
But Han Meng had a secret plan in his heart. He had known for a long time that Yue Qianzhong had been seriously injured in a battle with the two demons outside the Great Wall twenty years ago, and had only recovered 50% of his power so far, so he was not in a hurry. Although Yue Qianzhong's swordsmanship is powerful, he only needs to maintain a firm defense, fight around, and consume Yue Qianzhong's physical strength to become invincible.
Sure enough, after Yue Qianzhong practiced fifty moves, sweat appeared on his old face, and his sword skills were obviously a little more serious. At this time, Han Meng let out a loud roar and whizzed out three axes in Yue Qianzhong's sword net. He heard a few "ding-dong" sounds of gold and iron. Yue Qianzhong was knocked back several steps. Before Yue Qianzhong could stabilize his body, Han Meng rushed forward and struck another ax. Yue Qianzhong hurriedly swung his sword to hold it, only to hear another "dang" sound. Yue Qianzhong's mouth went numb and he almost couldn't hold the sword. Han Meng smiled sinisterly and punched Yue Qianzhong's sword with his left hand. At this moment, Yue Qianzhong finally couldn't help but take a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground.
It turns out that Han Meng was practicing Shaolin's "Hundred Steps Divine Fist", which focused on borrowing objects to hit objects and hitting cattle from a distance. This punch contained 100% of Han Meng's internal energy, which passed through Yue Qianzhong's sword and reached into his internal organs. Yue Qianzhong's internal strength was exhausted and he was immediately injured internally by the shock. It was difficult for him to continue fighting.
But I heard Han Meng say: "Old man, if you don't abandon your sword and admit defeat, I will spare your life!"
Yue Qianzhong gasped for breath and said painfully: "I lost, take your life, but there is no sword!"
Han Meng waved his hand, and a dozen men in powerful costumes came up, ready to capture Yue Qianzhong. Wang Zhen, Xu Tianbo and Ma Qianli were about to make a desperate rescue effort when suddenly a voice came from behind Han Meng and said coldly: "You are Han Meng!"
When Han Meng heard this voice, he felt a sudden burst of cold air behind him, a cold air that suffocated him and almost made him unable to move. He quickly turned over in the air, turned around and landed. Then he saw clearly that there was only a young man standing there, looking at him with a mocking look.
Han Meng became angry and cursed: "Boy, tell me your name and hide behind others. I think you are tired of living!"
That young man was Xiao Wuhen. He pulled out his sword and said coldly: "Since you are dead, there is no need to know who I am."
As soon as he finished speaking, Han Meng rushed forward with his ax and shouted, "Seek death, boy!" He waved his ax and the most violent killing was "Creating the World". ButAfter all, his ax did not touch Xiao Wuhen, although the ax was very fast and fierce. Xiao Wuhen had already thrust out a sword. It was a very strange sword that struck later but came first. It penetrated through the flaw in the "Create the World" move and stabbed Han Meng's throat, no more, no less, exactly three points. Han Meng felt his eyes go dark, his throat was cold, and he slowly fell down with fear and disbelief on his face.
Everyone was stunned and did not react. Xiao Wuhen had left, and the sound of his flute was heard again in the distance. The sad sound of the flute...
